checks.name: Unique IDs and rebuilt master record count
Student question payload excludes answer and test fields
Provenance contains availability metadata without source answer summaries
All exact codes valid and public objective metadata present
Text search finds exact stable ID, case insensitive and trimmed
All text tokens required; not treated as regex
Every theme/topic/level/difficulty filter matches independent predicate
Selection toggles immutably and student export excludes hidden solution
Every answer ID reconciles with question; marks and unofficial label
Export whitelist remains safe if question object contains answer properties

limitations: Not a real browser rendering test; coordinator must inspect and exercise browser UI.
Core tests validate stored bank data behavior, not scientific correctness of each bank answer.
